label: Update a row
gloss: change the row that already exists instead of adding a new one
why: Some records are news about a row that already exists: a task moved from pending to done. Adding a new row leaves the old one behind, and replacing the whole row throws away what the update did not mention, like the due date. Update finds the row with the same key and changes only the fields the update carries.
cue: when the message says 'X is now Y', you are updating a row, not adding one
task: Payroll says H-1 is done. Mark that row done on the Task Board, keeping its owner and due date.
notes: One field is not enough to find the row: H-1 has several tasks. The row is the same when hireId AND taskId match.
Try 'add a new row' first and look at the table.
